title: list_data_uses input
description: The data uses (O27) across every domain in one list, each with its decision state from OP-16, computed when read: what each application reads or writes, whether the data reaches an AI model, and whether a decision allows it. Open uses by default. Filters by domain (with the domains below it), application, state, AI, access and words; dataUseIds reads given uses, ended ones too. Writes nothing.

domainKey.description: Only uses of this domain and, unless includeSubtree is false, of the domains below it.

includeSubtree.description: False keeps the uses of domainKey itself only.

dataUseIds.description: Only these uses, whatever their state or end date (a use's record page). Each must exist.

states.description: Only uses in these decision states. counts.byState is for the other filters, before this one.

reachesAi.description: True keeps the uses whose data reaches an AI model; false keeps the others.

accessKeys.description: Only uses with these kinds of access.

text.description: Words that must appear in the application's name, the domain's path, the purpose, the record number or the AI service.

includeEnded.description: True adds the ended, retired and archived uses.
